meta_description:
239K likes, 964 comments - vogueindia on October 28, 2026: "For someone who has spent much of her career working towards the next big thing, Katrina Kaif (@katrinakaif) is discovering the unfamiliar pleasure of being content. There's a baby at home, a beauty business to run and, somewhere down the line, an unexpected fairy-tale character she'd quite like to play.

Read the full cover story at the link in bio.

Production: Imran Khatri Productions (@ikp.insta)

Outfit; Abu Jani Sandeep Khosla (@abujanisandeepkhosla). Choker; Keiyura Jewellery (@keiyura_jewelry). Earrings; Udaan (@udaan.jewellery). Payals; Surabhi Didwania (@motifsbysurabhididwania).".
